verdict.rationale: The docs show several background automation mechanisms. Snowpipe loads files automatically as they arrive in a stage instead of manual scheduled COPY runs. dbt Projects on Snowflake can deploy and orchestrate transformations on a managed runtime. Streams record changes so actions can be taken on them, dynamic tables are GA, and resource monitors auto-suspend warehouses at credit limits. However, none of this evidence shows general-purpose scheduled jobs or AI agents that act autonomously in the background, so delivery is limited to data-pipeline automation. Missing for 10: general scheduling/task orchestration documentation, autonomous AI-agent or background agent workflows, details on how dynamic tables refresh themselves, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
